sql: ALTER TABLE transactions ADD COLUMN reference_id text NOT NULL;
description: Add a non-null reference_id to transactions for the new clearinghouse integration.

reasons: NOT NULL without DEFAULT on 84M-row table
Will rewrite the table and block writes

sql: ALTER TABLE accounts DROP COLUMN balance_cents;
description: Remove the cached balance column from accounts; balances are computed live now.

reasons: ledger-job and statements-job actively read accounts.balance_cents
Drop will break high-criticality consumers immediately

sql: ALTER TABLE accounts RENAME COLUMN member_id TO holder_id;
description: Rename member_id to holder_id to match new domain language.

reasons: Rename without consumer migration will break joins

sql: ALTER TABLE plans ALTER COLUMN contribution_limit_individual TYPE bigint;
description: Widen contribution_limit_individual to bigint in case IRS limits ever exceed int range.

reasons: Type widening on small table completes near-instantly
enrollment-job already reads it as a number
